title: E-commerce Order List
summary: Order list page with top stat pills showing counts for pending, completed, and failed orders. Below is a searchable data table with order ID, date, customer name with avatar, payment method, status chips (Delivered, Out for Delivery, Ready to Pick, Dispatched), and a three-dot action menu per row. Pagination at bottom.
